segments.title: Lost something tiny? Ask AI
segments.say: Lost something tiny? Let AI search the photo for you.

segments.title: Snap 2-3 close photos
segments.say: Take two or three close, sharp photos of the area, in good light.

segments.text: Find a white earbud in these photos.

segments.say: Ask it to say where, next to something that doesn't move.
segments.text: Possible match: bottom left, next to the chair leg.

segments.title: Then check the spot
segments.say: AI can miss things or guess wrong, so check the spot yourself.
Save this for the next time you lose your keys, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
